decisions.rationale: Leading Swampert and Pelipper sets up immediate Drizzle rain and Swift Swim offensive pressure, with Wide Guard available to neutralize Garchomp's Earthquake and Rock Slide. Bringing Archaludon in the back enables instant 1-turn Electro Shot in rain while resisting Grass and Flying attacks, while Tsareena provides Queenly Majesty protection against Talonflame's Gale Wings priority and heavy Grass/Fighting damage.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Brought Swampert, Pelipper, Archaludon, Tsareena. Opponent team: Serperior (Focus Sash), Garchomp (Life Orb), Talonflame (Sharp Beak, Gale Wings), Aegislash (Leftovers), Manectric (Magnet), Rotom-Wash (Wide Lens). Strategy: Leverage Rain + Swift Swim Mega Swampert for fast damage; Pelipper Wide Guard blocks Garchomp spread moves; Tsareena's Queenly Majesty shuts down Gale Wings priority.

decisions.rationale: Lead Serperior+Talonflame. Tailwind lets Serperior outspeed Swift Swim Swampert and Focus Sash survives one hit; Leaf Storm OHKOes Swampert. Manectric is the Pelipper/Electro Shot answer: Lightning Rod absorbs Electric and Thunderbolt OHKOes Pelipper. Back Garchomp gives an Electric immunity and Earthquake pressure on Archaludon/Slowking, completing the rain plan.
decisions.notebook: Opponent Golden Gate: likely Pelipper+Mega Swampert rain with Archaludon; Slowking may Tailwind/TR, Mimikyu TR, Tsareena anti-priority. Preferred construction: lead Serperior/Talonflame, back Manectric/Garchomp. Verified: Serperior Leaf Storm OHKOes Swampert (100.5%+ Mega, 115%+ base) but 90 acc; Manectric Magnet Thunderbolt OHKOes Pelipper 172%+; Archaludon Electro Shot OHKOes Talonflame in rain, but Manectric Lightning Rod absorbs and boosts; Garchomp immune Electric and EQ OHKOes Slowking, pressures Archaludon (spread/+1 Def EQ not guaranteed; needs chip or SD). Talonflame Tailwind turn1 is essential; if Pelipper also gets Tailwind, Swift Swim Swampert can outspeed, so remove Swampert immediately. Swampert Ice Punch 60-85% Serperior, Hurricane 83-124% but Sash saves; Wave Crash OHKOes Talonflame in rain. Aegislash is the dedicated Mimikyu/Slowking/TR answer: immune Sludge Bomb, resists Play Rough, Blade Shadow Ball threatens both, but beware Mimikyu Shadow Claw vs Blade. If opponent reveals Mimikyu/Slowking TR or drops Archaludon, consider swapping Garchomp for Aegislash. If they keep Archaludon rain, keep Garchomp. Tsareena Power Whip can OHKO Manectric sometimes and blocks Gale Wings priority; Serperior resists Power Whip, Talonflame Brave Bird/Flare Blitz can OHKO but not guaranteed; Manectric Flamethrower 2HKO. Rotom-Wash is optional pivot vs Swampert but Tsareena OHKOes it and it lacks Electric absorb; usually inferior to Manectric.

decisions.rationale: Serperior outspeeds non-Mega Swampert and threatens a 4x Grass OHKO with Leaf Storm, while Focus Sash prevents Mega Swampert from KOing it first. Switching Swampert to Tsareena safely absorbs Leaf Storm for ~20% damage and activates Queenly Majesty to block Gale Wings priority. Pelipper's 100% accurate Hurricane in Rain breaks Serperior's Focus Sash, neutering its threat while preserving Swampert at 100% HP for a later Rain sweep.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Brought Swampert, Pelipper, Archaludon, Tsareena. Opponent lead Serperior + Talonflame. Tsareena Queenly Majesty blocks Gale Wings priority. Swampert preserved for late-game Mega Swift Swim sweep.

decisions.rationale: Leaf Storm OHKOes both base (115.9%+) and Mega Swampert (100.5%+) at 4x SE; verified via engine. Serperior outspeeds base Swampert; even if Mega Swift Swim lets Swampert act first, Focus Sash guarantees Serperior survives any single hit and fires Leaf Storm. Tailwind is essential: Brave Bird only does 39-89% to Pelipper, so attacking is inferior. Tailwind ensures we outspeed Swift Swim Swampert if Leaf Storm's 90% accuracy fails, and gives lasting speed control.
decisions.notebook: Opponent Golden Gate: Pelipper+Mega Swampert rain core, back Archaludon/Tsareena/Mimikyu/Slowking-Galar. Verified T1: Leaf Storm OHKOes base Swampert 115.9-256% and Mega Swampert 100.5-219.4% (Contrary, Focus Sash, exact 127 SpA). Brave Bird vs Pelipper only 39.5-88.9%—never worth it over Tailwind. Serperior outspeeds base Swampert; Focus Sash guarantees survival vs any single hit even if Swift Swim Mega Swampert moves first. Manectric Magnet Thunderbolt OHKOes Pelipper 172%+; Lightning Rod absorbs Electro Shot from Archaludon. Garchomp EQ OHKOes Slowking, pressures Archaludon (needs chip/SD for +1 Def). Archaludon Electro Shot OHKOes Talonflame in rain—never leave Talonflame in vs Archaludon without Manectric pivot. Tsareena Queenly Majesty blocks Gale Wings priority; Serperior resists Power Whip. Mimikyu/Slowking TR threats: consider Aegislash if revealed. Plan: prioritize removing Swampert fast, maintain Tailwind, pivot to Manectric for rain/Electric coverage. If Pelipper survives T1, Manectric Thunderbolt is the answer. Watch for Swampert Protect wasting Leaf Storm—Contrary +2 SpA makes next Leaf Storm even stronger.

decisions.rationale: Serperior at +2 SpA threatens Pelipper with Leaf Storm (91.6–142.5%). Switching Pelipper to Archaludon safely quad-resists Leaf Storm (14.7–38.8%) while preserving Pelipper and rain. Queenly Majesty blocks Talonflame's Gale Wings Brave Bird priority. Tsareena uses 100% accurate Knock Off to eliminate the 5% HP Serperior.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Brought Swampert, Pelipper, Archaludon, Tsareena. Opponent lead Serperior + Talonflame. Queenly Majesty blocks Gale Wings priority. Swampert preserved for late-game Swift Swim sweep.

decisions.rationale: Serperior at 5% is disposable: +2 Leaf Storm vs Pelipper is 91.6-180.7% (~87.5% OHKO). Talonflame MUST Protect—rain Weather Ball is a guaranteed OHKO on Talonflame (140-214%). If Leaf Storm misses the kill, Talonflame stays at 100% to clean up. Brave Bird on Tsareena fails entirely (Gale Wings priority blocked by Queenly Majesty). Flare Blitz in rain (33-61%) isn't worth the Weather Ball risk.
decisions.notebook: KEY INTERACTIONS: (1) Queenly Majesty blocks Gale Wings Brave Bird vs Tsareena when Talonflame at full HP—never Brave Bird Tsareena unless Talonflame is damaged. (2) Rain Weather Ball from Pelipper OHKOes Talonflame (140-214%)—always Protect or pivot Talonflame when Pelipper can act. Hurricane only 52-78% to Talonflame. (3) Leaf Storm +2 vs Pelipper is only neutral (Grass vs Water/Flying=1x), 91.6-180.7%. Manectric Thunderbolt is the guaranteed Pelipper answer (4x SE). (4) Flare Blitz vs Tsareena in rain: 33-61%. Knock Off Tsareena→Talonflame: 40-58%. (5) Serperior +2 Leaf Storm vs Tsareena: 34.6-63.3% (0.5x). STRATEGY: Remove Pelipper first to break rain. Manectric pivots for Electric coverage and Lightning Rod vs Electro Shot. Garchomp EQ pressures Archaludon/Slowking. Watch Archaludon switch-ins (Grass resist, Stamina). Mimikyu/Slowking TR threats require speed control awareness. Tsareena at 74% can be finished by Garchomp or Manectric later.

decisions.rationale: Manectric > Garchomp: Lightning Rod absorbs Electro Shot (confirmed OHKO on Talonflame 113-163% in rain, fires in 1 turn). Manectric resists Flash Cannon, neutral to Draco Meteor; Garchomp risks Draco Meteor OHKO (79-175%). Garchomp EQ only 33-73% vs +1 Def Archaludon at 76%—no KO. Manectric Thunderbolt guarantees Pelipper KO (151-373%) if it pivots in. Safest defensive profile for this board.
decisions.notebook: KEY CALCS CONFIRMED: Electro Shot in rain fires in 1 turn and OHKOes Talonflame (113-163%). Draco Meteor vs Garchomp: 79-175% (possible OHKO)—never switch Garchomp into healthy Archaludon. Garchomp EQ vs +1 Def Archaludon: only 33-73%, no KO. Manectric Thunderbolt vs Pelipper: 151-373% guaranteed OHKO. Power Whip vs Garchomp: 33-72% (survivable). Manectric resists Flash Cannon (0.5x), neutral to Draco Meteor, immune to Electro Shot via Lightning Rod. STRATEGY: Manectric is primary Archaludon/Electro Shot answer and Pelipper check. Garchomp best used as late-game cleaner or vs non-Dragon foes. Rain Weather Ball from Pelipper still OHKOes Talonflame—always Protect/pivot. Watch Swampert Mega (Swift Swim); Thunderbolt is 0x vs Water/Ground. Mimikyu/Slowking TR threats require speed control awareness. Garchomp EQ safe vs Talonflame ally (Flying immunity).

decisions.rationale: Tsareena's Queenly Majesty blocks Talonflame's Gale Wings priority Brave Bird while Rain halves incoming Fire damage. Manectric's Lightning Rod absorbs Electric moves, so Archaludon cannot use Electro Shot. Double-targeting Manectric with Knock Off and Draco Meteor guarantees a KO, removing Lightning Rod for the rest of the match, while Knock Off avoids High Jump Kick crash damage if Manectric uses Protect.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Brought Swampert, Pelipper, Archaludon, Tsareena. Opponent lead Serperior + Talonflame; brought Manectric. Queenly Majesty blocks Gale Wings priority moves completely while active. Rain cuts Fire damage in half and enables 1-turn Electro Shot / Swift Swim.

decisions.rationale: Brave Bird guarantees KO on Tsareena (74.9-164.6%). Snarl drops Archaludon SpA by 1, reducing Electro Shot vs Talonflame to 41-121% (survivable) and Draco Meteor vs Manectric to 54-96% (survives). Manectric's Lightning Rod immunity makes it the ideal Archaludon answer. This removes Tsareena while protecting both actives from Archaludon's rain-boosted Electro Shot.
decisions.notebook: KEY CALCS: Snarl -1 SpA makes Archaludon Electro Shot 41-121% vs Talonflame (survivable) and Draco Meteor 54-96% vs Manectric (survives). Without Snarl, Electro Shot OHKOs Talonflame (62-181%) and Draco Meteor can OHKO Manectric (80-143%). Manectric Lightning Rod = full Electro Shot immunity; primary Archaludon answer. Talonflame Brave Bird OHKOs Tsareena; in rain Flare Blitz is halved so prefer Brave Bird. Garchomp EQ vs +1 Def Archaludon only 33-73%; never switch Garchomp into healthy Archaludon (Draco Meteor 79-175%). Thunderbolt OHKOs Pelipper (151-373%) but 0x vs Swampert. STRATEGY: Use Snarl to weaken Archaludon before it attacks; Manectric is the Archaludon/Pelipper check. Garchomp is a late-game cleaner or answer to non-Dragon foes. Watch for Mega Swampert Swift Swim in rain and Pelipper Weather Ball. Mimikyu/Slowking not brought this game.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Protecting with Tsareena safely stalls out the final turn of opponent Tailwind and shields her from dual attacks. Switching Archaludon to Swampert resets Archaludon's -3 SpA drops and positions Swampert on the field. On Turn 5, with Tailwind expired, Mega Swampert in Rain (224 Speed) will outspeed both Garchomp and Talonflame, allowing an immediate Ice Punch KO on Garchomp. Queenly Majesty continues blocking Gale Wings priority.

EQ→Archaludon 29-58% at +2 Def (spread). Archaludon -3 SpA Electro Shot→Talonflame 26-75%, Draco Meteor→Garchomp 31-79%. Tsareena Power Whip→Garchomp 49-71%. decisions.rationale: Mega Swampert in Rain reaches 244 Speed, outspeeding both opposing Pokémon. 4x Ice Punch from Mega Swampert deals 78.1-139.9% to Garchomp (90% HP), while Tsareena's Queenly Majesty blocks Gale Wings priority from Talonflame. Knock Off from Tsareena into Garchomp guarantees the KO on min rolls or retargets to Talonflame if Garchomp faints first.

The recoil damage is capped at Talonflame's remaining 28% HP (~15 HP), easily keeping Swampert alive to seal Game 1. Tsareena targets Knock Off as a safe secondary attack.

decisions.rationale: Garchomp fainted, must pass. Talonflame is last mon; Wave Crash is guaranteed OHKO regardless. Protect only delays death. Best line is Flare Blitz to KO Tsareena at 15% HP, hoping Swampert chooses Ice Punch or High Horsepower (immune) over Wave Crash. Brave Bird stronger in rain but notebook recommends Flare Blitz vs Tsareena.

Tsareena has Queenly Majesty blocking priority—always use Flare Blitz not Brave Bird on it. Mega Swampert Ice Punch 4x OHKOs Garchomp; Wave Crash OHKOs Talonflame in rain (184-381%). Garchomp essential for Pelipper (Rock Slide 2x) and Archaludon (EQ 2x); preserve it. Archaludon has Stamina (+1 Def per hit) and Electro Shot; Garchomp immune to Electro Shot. Talonflame Speed 195 vs Swampert 180-244 in rain is uncertain—cannot rely on outspeeding.

reflections.summary: Tsareena's Queenly Majesty completely shut down Talonflame's Gale Wings priority, allowing Mega Swampert under Rain to outspeed and sweep Garchomp and Talonflame late game.
reflections.adjustment: Stick with the Mega Swampert rain core and Tsareena anti-priority plan, but prepare for Aegislash or Rotom-Wash inclusions by managing Archaludon positioning carefully.

reflections.summary: Lost mainly because the preview plan was wrong for this rain team: we led or kept Serperior and Manectric, had no relevant Mega answer, and let Pelipper keep rain active while Mega Swampert outsped us. Garchomp died to Ice Punch after a failed Protect chain, and Talonflame could not remove Swampert before Wave Crash.
reflections.adjustment: Next game change the lead to Talonflame and Garchomp, use Tailwind turn 1, and keep Garchomp as the Swampert check by switching on predicted Ice Punch instead of chaining Protect; pressure Pelipper while respecting Wide Guard before committing attacks into Mega Swampert.
reflections.notebook: Opponent rain core is Pelipper with Drizzle and Damp Rock into Mega Swampert with Swift Swim; Swampert is likely Adamant and uses Ice Punch for Garchomp and Wave Crash for Talonflame. Pelipper carries Wide Guard, so spread Rock Slide and Earthquake can be blocked. Tsareena Queenly Majesty blocks Gale Wings priority Brave Bird; use Flare Blitz or non-priority attacks against it, and expect Wide Lens Power Whip. Archaludon has Stamina and gains Defense from hits; Garchomp is its best answer because it is immune to Electro Shot and can use Earthquake. Opponent uses Protect to bait and targets our checks. Our side had no relevant Mega evolution; against Swampertite, use Tailwind, preserve Garchomp, avoid Protect chains, and consider Focus Sash or speed control. Mimikyu and Slowking-Galar are reserve Trick Room options if rain is disrupted.
